Hi! I’m **Christiaan Verhoef**, a technical strategist, researcher, and open-source systems designer focused on AI, sustainability, and supply chain innovation. I currently lead **[Value Chain Hackers](https://github.com/Value-Chain-Hackers)**, an open lab hosted at Windesheim University of Applied Sciences, where we build research infrastructure that helps organizations turn sustainable practices into competitive advantages.

My work spans over 20 roles since 2009 across Europe and the Caribbean, with a focus on:

- Coordinating the **Spark! Living Lab** at Windesheim since 2020, where I’ve led projects in blockchain simulation, agile educational transformation, supply chain digitization, and forensic COVID-19 research.

- Co-founding the **Tonomy Foundation**, where I co-lead the development of decentralized governance and identity tooling.

- Driving curriculum innovation at **Aeres Hogeschool Dronten**, where I introduced Scrum and helped merge eight courses into a single integrated innovation program that led to successful startup incubation.

- Supporting privacy-first AI infrastructure and data tooling in research settings using technologies like **Supabase**, **Docker**, **Open WebUI**, and **graph databases**.

I specialize in building systems that are both technically robust and easy to adopt — particularly in settings where researchers, educators, and SMEs need tools that work out of the box and respect user autonomy.

I work daily with **R**, `ggplot2`, `quarto`, **n8n**, and open science stacks to automate reporting, map complex value chains, and experiment with decentralized knowledge flows.

You can explore more of my work here:
- 🌍 Lab portal: [valuechainhackers.xyz](https://valuechainhackers.xyz)
- 🧪 Research platform: [eco.viridis.info](https://eco.viridis.info/)
- 💻 Code & infrastructure: [github.com/Value-Chain-Hackers](https://github.com/Value-Chain-Hackers)

If you're building systems to make research, sustainability, or governance more accessible — let’s talk.
